programme.title: Brest vs Olympique Marseille - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 1
programme.desc: Brest won their most recent Ligue 1 match against Marseille and can win two games in a row against OM for the second time in their history in the top-flight after 1980-1984, when SB29 won 7-2 and 3-0. Brest have never managed two clean sheets in a row against Marseille in L1. Marseille are entering their 75th season in Ligue 1, the highest total ahead of St Etienne. On the other hand, Brest, who will compete in the Champions League in 2024-25 for the first time, will be playing their 19th season in L1, the lowest total amongst the current top-flight teams.

programme.title: Reims vs Lille - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 1
programme.desc: Since Reims returned to Ligue 1 in 2018-19, their head-to-head record with Lille has been perfectly balanced with four wins each and three draws. Lille have won two of their last four away trips to Reims, as many as across their previous 21.

programme.title: Rennes vs Olympique Lyonnais - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 1
programme.desc: Rennes have won four of their last six Ligue 1 matches against Lyon, as many wins as across their previous 13 such meetings combined. So far in 2024, no side has won as many points as Lyon in Ligue 1 even though they’ve also conceded 28 goals in the process, the highest total amongst sides to remain in France’s top-flight for the 2024-25 season alongside Strasbourg.

programme.desc: Le Havre have not won any of their last seven Ligue 1 games against PSG, since a 3-1 victory in October 1999. programme.desc: Paris SG have won 12 of their last 13 matches against Montpellier in Ligue 1, as many as in the previous 36 meetings. programme.title: Olympique Lyonnais vs Monaco - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 2
programme.desc: This will be the 116th meeting between Lyon and Monaco in Ligue 1, the most played fixture between teams currently in the top-flight. OL have 44 wins to ASM's 47. Lyon have won their last six home games against Monaco in Ligue 1, their longest such run against a club featuring in the top-flight this season.

programme.title: Olympique Marseille vs Reims - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 2
programme.desc: Marseille have won four of their last five games against Reims in Ligue 1, however, they lost their most recent league encounter against them. Marseille have won their last two home games against Reims in Ligue 1 but have never made it three in a row against them in the top-flight.

programme.title: Lens vs Brest - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 2
programme.desc: Since Lens returned to Ligue 1 ahead of the 2020/21 season, their record against Brest has been perfectly balanced with three wins for each side and two draws; Lens have the opportunity to win two consecutive top-flight matches against SB29 for the first time since August-December 1986. Lens have lost just one of their 12 matches against Brittany clubs since the start of the 2022/23 Ligue 1 season, however, that loss came against Brest on MD1 last season.

programme.title: Practice 2 - F1 Qatar Airways British Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: Drivers return to the track for a longer afternoon session under evolving conditions. With more rubber laid down, teams focus on race simulations and fine-tuning balance for both qualifying and Sunday’s main event at the iconic Silverstone circuit.

programme.title: Sprint Race - Aragon GP - Moto GP
programme.desc: A short, action-packed sprint sees the MotoGP field fight for valuable championship points. Expect aggressive overtakes and non-stop excitement on every lap of this high-stakes showdown.

programme.title: Main Race - Aragon GP - Moto GP
programme.desc: The main event of the weekend sees the MotoGP stars battle it out over full race distance at the Aragon GP. With fast corners, heavy braking zones, and a passionate crowd, it’s a true test of skill, strategy, and stamina as riders chase vital championship points.

programme.title: Practice 1 - F1 Qatar Airways British Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: The Formula 1 weekend begins at Silverstone with the first practice session. Teams take to the historic British circuit to test setups, assess tyre performance, and gather crucial data ahead of qualifying. A key opportunity to evaluate early pace and upgrades.

programme.title: Qualifying - FIA Formula 3 Championship - Silverstone Round
programme.desc: The 2025 FIA Formula 3 Championship is an open-wheel racing category serving as the third tier of formula racing in the FIA Global Pathway. The category will be run in support of selected rounds of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship. As the championship is a spec series, all teams and drivers competing in the championship will run the same car, the Dallara F3 2025. Prema Racing are the reigning Teams' Champions

programme.title: Qualifying - FIA Formula 2 Championship -Silverstone Round
programme.desc: The 2025 FIA Formula 2 Championship is an open-wheel racing category serving as the second tier of formula racing in the FIA Global Pathway. The category will be run in support of selected rounds of the 2025 Formula One World Championship. As the championship is a spec series, all teams and drivers competing in the championship will run the same car, the new Dallara F2 2024. Invicta Racing are the reigning Team's Champions.

programme.title: Practice 2 - F1 Qatar Airways British Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: Drivers return to the track for a longer afternoon session under evolving conditions. With more rubber laid down, teams focus on race simulations and fine-tuning balance for both qualifying and Sunday’s main event at the iconic Silverstone circuit.

programme.title: Fast Zone 2025
programme.desc: Covering everything from prototypes to endurance racing, karting to airplanes and even some real oddities… With both tradition and a fresh take on motorsport, Fast/Zone is the ultimate resource for everything that is fast and fascinating!

programme.title: GOODYEAR FIA European Truck Racing 2025-Slovakiaring
programme.desc: 1,000 horsepower - 0 concern for the heir trucks' integrity. This is the winning formula of the FIA Truck Racing Championship. These matadors deliver thrilling action across four races per event in an oversized battle royal! Forget tactics—prepare for raw, tough racing and plenty of collisions!

programme.title: GP Confidential 2025 Magazine
programme.desc: Explore the sporting secrets of F1. Across 25 episodes and in crisp 3D animations, we analyses the technical details, which decide which teams make the most of the rules - and which need to go back to the drawing board. Complemented by features on historical milestones as well as race previews - GP Confidential is the perfect treat for any F1 fan.

programme.title: Sprint Race - FIA Formula 3 Championship - Silverstone Round

As the championship is a spec series, all teams and drivers competing in the championship will run the same car, the Dallara F3 2025. Prema Racing are the reigning Teams' Champions

programme.title: DTM Show 2025-Zandvoort
programme.desc: DTM. The embodiment of Motorsport tradition. Having just turned 40, the DTM combines a unique fascination and familiarity with an unmistakable dynamic, signified by the rebranding with a new logo! Seven different manufacturers – ten different winners on six brands (Audi, BMW, Mercedes, Lamborghini, Porsche and Ferrari) through twelve races are but one testament to the unique competitive balance that makes every DTM weekend a revelation! And with the addition of Ford, the palette of different brands is only increasing!

programme.desc: The final practice session at Silverstone gives teams one last chance to refine setups before qualifying. With fuel loads lowered and grip increasing, this session offers a glimpse at true pace and race-day readiness on one of F1’s most demanding circuits.

programme.title: Lille / Dunkirk
programme.desc: On a small cloud since its direct qualification in the 8th finals of the Champions League, LOSC is in full confidence before this Flanders derby against the USL Dunkirk, 4th in Ligue 2, in difficulty since early 2025 with only two victories on the clock. Guided by an untenable Sahraoui Osame on his rhythm changes with 3 goals and 2 assists on his last 5 games, a Vito Mannone in full confidence after his heroic match in the Vélodrome in 1/16 finals or a Jonathan David Surgical in the last gesture with 20 goals all competitions combined, the Dogues have all the cards in hand to continue to produce Orders by Bruno Genesio and win their ticket for the 1/4 finals against Maritimes who rely on Yacine Bammou's experience, the technical quality of Naatan Skyttä and La Vista du Maestro, Enzo Bardeli, to try to thwart all forecasts at the Pierre Mauroy stadium.

programme.title: England / Germany
programme.desc: CLAP FINDING IN APOTOTHEMENT AT THE EURO ESPERS 2025: Germany defies England in the final in Bratislava for electric revenge between two European football giants. Beaten by the Mannschaft in the group phase (2-1), the Young Lions of Lee Carsley have since raised the cursor. Brilliant against Spain (1-3) in quarters, then solid against the Netherlands (2-1), they arrived launched, carried by a sparkling Harvey Elliott: 3 goals and 1 decisive pass in the matches with direct elimination. But Germany impresses even more. Intouchables in hens (9 points), Antonio Di Salvo's men first snatched their place in half against Italy (3-2 A.P.), before offset France (3-0). With 14 goals scored in 5 games, their attack is formidable, led by Nick Woltemade, top scorer of the tournament (6 goals). Between a revengeful England and a Germany in full control, this final promises intensity, talent and fireworks.

programme.title: Brest / Dunkirk
programme.desc: Just eliminated by Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League play-offs (10-0), the Brestois stadium put on the French Cup to relaunch itself against the USL Dunkirk, 3rd in Ligue 2, in search of a new big blow after having dropped the LOSC in the previous round. Worn by a Ludovic Ajorque Back from injury, author of 6 goals since early 2025, a Mahdi Camara trio - Pierre Lees -Melou - Hugo Magnetti very complementary in the midfield or even a hyper active Kenny Lala in his right corridor, the Bretons have all the ingredients to qualify for the first time in their 1/2 final of the French Cup Decisive parades of Ewen Jaouen, hero of qualification against Lille, the technical quality of Naatan Skyttä and the experience of Yacine Bammou to continue their magnificent epic at the Francis Le Blé stadium.

programme.desc: In the women's tournament of this Wimbledon 2025, very difficult to plan which players will animate the matches. programme.title: Betis Seville / FC Barcelona
programme.desc: Broadcast of a Laliga EA Sports match, Spanish football championship, the highest football competition in Spain. This professional competition, placed under the supervision of the Spanish Football Federation, was founded in 1928 and is called Primera Division until 2008. programme.title: England / Germany
programme.desc: CLAP FINDING IN APOTOTHEMENT AT THE EURO ESPERS 2025: Germany defies England in the final in Bratislava for electric revenge between two European football giants. Beaten by the Mannschaft in the group phase (2-1), the Young Lions of Lee Carsley have since raised the cursor. Brilliant against Spain (1-3) in quarters, then solid against the Netherlands (2-1), they arrived launched, carried by a sparkling Harvey Elliott: 3 goals and 1 decisive pass in the matches with direct elimination. But Germany impresses even more. Intouchables in hens (9 points), Antonio Di Salvo's men first snatched their place in half against Italy (3-2 A.P.), before offset France (3-0). With 14 goals scored in 5 games, their attack is formidable, led by Nick Woltemade, top scorer of the tournament (6 goals). Between a revengeful England and a Germany in full control, this final promises intensity, talent and fireworks.
